sections.title: Burt's characterisation
sections.line: Burt, chapter on Cancer (pdf pp. 135–174): pdf p135, p149 and p144.

quotes.quote: Cancer, the Cosmic Womb, is also the first Water sign.

The archetype of Cancer is the Cosmic Womb in which the seeds of creativity grow and burst forth in diverse ways—biological, artistic or intuitive creativity, imaginative creativity, even business creativity.
Cancer is a cardinal sign and for many a Cancer, business is the strongest creative outlet in the horoscope.
In the shell-home, Cancer is safe and protected and has everything comfortably arranged.

quotes.quote: The Magna Mater is the most ancient personal manifestation of divinity found around the world.
Cancer is attached to the past—tradition, home and hearth.
The Mother Goddess opposes Old Man Winter.
the Cancer archetype or Jung’s Magna Mater, for instance
The Moon, Cancer’s ruler, has been called in both India and the West (in Plato’s writings, particularly) the Giver of Form.
